title: Shell warmup
description:
Amaka, leaning on the partition: "First task — settle into the SOC workstation. There is a folder called `intro` under your home directory. Open the README inside, find the TRAN flag printed at the bottom, and hand it back."

The shell is real enough — type `help` if you need to see what the box supports. In your Stage 0 handover note (final task) you will document every command you actually ran. Amaka reads it.
